name: brand_kit_update
description: Update name, description, status, design_md, or atoms on an owned brand kit. Only provided fields change. @see guides_get('brand-kit')

atoms.description: Structured brand atoms (palette, typography, logo, voice, imagery). Partial updates are merged — object keys descend recursively, arrays replace the whole array. To change one color, send the complete palette array, echoing each entry's id (the server owns it; an entry without one keeps the id of the stored entry it matches, else gets a new one) — two swatches may share a hex and two typography.families entries a name, and the id is what tells them apart. Templates edits replace the visible list: send back every `templates` entry you keep from brand_kit_get view=full (an omitted one is deleted). Entries with hidden:true are kept by the server; `hidden` and `aspect_ratio_candidates` are ignored. A missing bbox on logo.variants keeps the stored one. user_rule = append ONE hard-ban rule (prefer brand_kit_add_rule); user_rule_delete = rule id to remove. rules = advisory prose only, NOT enforced — hard bans go via user_rule. The taxonomy tree and free-text assets are NOT writable as lists (sections/texts are ignored): retouch one node at a time with section (the sections are FIXED: preset logo|colors|typography|text_styles|assets|templates|voice materialises that home; any other preset or free {kind, title} is ROUTED into a subsection of its home and never becomes a new top-level section), section_update, section_remove (DESTRUCTIVE on a canonical section — it takes its whole family with it; use section_update enabled:false to merely hide one), section_reorder, subsection, subsection_update, subsection_remove, subsection_reorder ({section_id, order: [subsection ids]}), section_item, section_item_update, section_item_move ({id, section_id, subsection_id}: refiles an entry under another node, carrying its rules; moving an asset to subsection_id "slot:library" keeps it out of generation), section_item_remove (DESTRUCTIVE in the home section of that entry — it deletes the swatch/face/text itself and every reference to it; anywhere else it only unfiles), section_rule, subsection_rule, item_rule, kit_rule ({polarity, text}: a rule binding the WHOLE brand, no node id), rule_update, rule_remove, text, text_update, text_remove — each addressed by an id from brand_kit_get. motion (how the brand animates) is written only via motion_update (merge-patch; ease values are GSAP names, steps(n) or cubic-bezier(); style picks closed words: preset calm|elegant|balanced|snappy|playful|stop_motion, loop none|seamless — the brand's default ending for new videos; each video can override it, logo fade|pop|draw_on|wipe|assemble|focus|slam|glitch|static|custom, text fade_up|rise|words|letters|type|decode|slam|wipe|static|custom, camera locked|drift|push_in|punch|shake, end_card logo|logo_tagline|logo_cta|none|custom — custom means the logo_animation/type_animation/end_card prose holds it; transitions prefer/avoid/signature take ONLY catalog ids cut|dissolve|whip|zoom_through|wipe|colour_sweep|circle|push|focus_pull|glitch|flash, whip/push optionally :left|:right|:up|:down and wipe :left|:right|:top|:bottom|:center (e.g. whip:left); anything else is refused) and motion_clear: true. A fixed slot (brand_kit_get section_slots) may be addressed as "slot:<slug>" even before it exists: subsection_id of section_item / section_item_move, node_id of subsection_rule (e.g. {node_id: "slot:imagery", polarity, text}); subsection accepts {section_id, slot} to materialise one. Pass null to clear all atoms, which requires user_requested_overwrite when the owner has edited them.

description.description: Max 5000 chars. Pass null to clear.

design_md.description: Markdown design tokens. Pass null to clear.

status.description: Set ready once the user is happy with the kit. The server sets extracting and error itself.

user_requested_overwrite.description: Set only after the user confirms replacing brand-kit content they edited themselves.
